results.title: Foreign Investors Target Top Ten Stocks as IHSG Corrects to 6,384
results.body: Foreign investors were net buyers of the ten most purchased stocks on Monday as the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) corrected to 6,384.72. The IHSG closed at 6,384.72, down 0.88% (56.43 points) with a low of 6,381 and a high of 6,451, total volume of 26.78 billion shares and transaction value of Rp 11.77 trillion, while foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 510.07 billion. The net‑buy amounts were: PT Timah Tbk (TINS) Rp 50.02 billion, PT Petrosea Tbk (PTRO) Rp 37.9 billion, PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk (COIN) Rp 31.19 billion, PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) Rp 29.42 billion, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) Rp 23.11 billion, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) Rp 22.72 billion, PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) Rp 21.51 billion, PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG) Rp 20.91 billion, PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk (LSIP) Rp 16.09 billion, and PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) Rp 12.69 billion. In total, 354 stocks fell, 280 rose and 156 were unchanged, making these ten stocks among the net‑buy leaders despite overall foreign net selling.

results.title: Foreign investors sell shares of major banks and Prajogo‑linked stocks
results.body: Foreign investors net sold shares of major banks and Prajogo‑linked stocks during the week of 14–18 September 2026. The largest net sell was PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) with Rp798 billion, followed by PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) with Rp443.2 billion, PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) with Rp193.2 billion, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) with Rp189.9 billion, PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) with Rp166.3 billion, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) with Rp132.6 billion, PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) with Rp95 billion, PT Timah Tbk (TINS) with Rp47.7 billion, PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT) with Rp45 billion and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) with Rp44.6 billion. Foreign investors’ net sell for the week totaled Rp1.84 trillion, contributing to a 1.53% decline in the IHSG to 6,441,159 and a 1.58% drop in market capitalization to Rp11,266 trillion, while average daily transaction value, frequency and volume fell 6.95%, 14.73% and 20.71% respectively. The sell‑off coincided with the Federal Reserve’s 25‑basis‑point rate hike to a target range of 3.75‑4% on 16 September 2026 and analysts’ view that further US rate increases may prompt Bank Indonesia to consider similar moves.

results.title: IHSG Opens Weaker at Start of Week, Pressured by Global Sentiment
results.body: The IHSG opened 1.36% lower at 6,452 on Monday as rising oil prices above $100 per barrel and an 85% probability of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike at the September 15-16 FOMC meeting pressured sentiment. Foreign investors sold a net Rp2.31 trillion in the regular market, while trading volume reached 6.53 billion shares worth Rp3.06 trillion. Technical indicators show a hammer pattern at the 6,475-6,375 support zone with the index holding above its 20-day moving average at 6,533, suggesting a potential rebound. Brokerages offered divergent outlooks: BRI Danareksa sees a constructive bias targeting resistance at 6,600-6,700 and favors UNTR, IMPC, and TINS; Phintraco expects sideways movement between 6,450-6,700 and picks ANTM, ASII, EMAS, MDKA, and ISAT; CGS International forecasts varied gains with support at 6,465-6,390 and resistance at 6,620-6,695, recommending TAPG, AALI, ISAT, TINS, AMMN, and EMAS; Panin Sekuritas anticipates further weakness due to geopolitical tensions and foreign outflows, selecting INET, BRMS, and INCO.

results.title: PT Timah Revises 2026 Budget After First-Half Net Profit Jumps 805% and Exceeds Full-Year Targets
results.body: PT Timah (Persero) Tbk announced it will revise its 2026 work plan and budget (RKAP) after first-half 2026 results far surpassed full-year targets. Revenue reached Rp10.4 trillion, up 147% year-on-year, achieving 67% of the full-year target of Rp15.35 trillion. Net profit surged 805% to Rp2.7 trillion, exceeding the full-year target of Rp1.6 trillion, while EBITDA of Rp3.9 trillion also surpassed the full-year target of Rp2.9 trillion. Total assets rose 21% to Rp16.4 trillion, driven by cash growth to Rp4 trillion, and liabilities increased 13% to Rp5.9 trillion due to dividend obligations from the June 12, 2026 shareholder meeting, which were paid in July 2026.

results.title: Analysts Project Continued Strength for Metal Miners ANTM, INCO, and TINS Through Late 2026
results.body: KB Valbury Sekuritas and Phintraco Sekuritas maintain a positive outlook for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, and PT Timah Tbk for the remainder of 2026, citing solid first-half performance and supportive commodity prices. ANTM posted revenue of Rp62.7 trillion in the first half of 2026, up 6.3% year-on-year, with KB Valbury setting a target price of Rp4,000 per share on the back of a gold price rebound. INCO recorded revenue of US$543 million, a 27.3% increase, and KB Valbury assigns a Rp5,600 target price driven by rising global nickel prices and the completion of its Electric Furnace 3 rebuild in June 2026. TINS achieved 41% of its annual tin ore production target in the first half, and Phintraco highlights a global tin supply deficit of around 3% and strong demand from electronics and AI sectors as key catalysts for the second half.

results.title: PT Timah Tbk expects Perpres No.79/2026 to boost performance and net income through 2026
results.body: PT Timah Tbk says the implementation of Presidential Regulation No.79/2026 on tin land governance will act as a catalyst for its performance through the end of 2026. The company highlighted that its first‑half 2026 production of 12,232 t of tin ore and 10,865 t of refined tin, together with a 52 % rise in average tin price to US$49,794/ton, already pushed revenue and net‑profit targets above the original 2026 RKAP of Rp15.4 trillion and Rp1.6 trillion. Consequently, PT Timah Tbk has proposed higher 2026 targets, expecting continued price strength as LME tin prices are up 38.13 % year‑on‑year and export sales, which account for 97 % of total, remain dominated by Asia (75 %) with China contributing 35 % of shipments. Management expects the regulatory improvements in upstream‑to‑downstream governance to further boost productivity and net income in the second half of 2026.

results.title: PT Timah Tbk prepares revised 2026 RKAP after 147% revenue jump and 805% profit surge
results.body: PT Timah Tbk announced that it is preparing a revised 2026 corporate work plan (RKAP) after the first‑half 2026 results far exceeded the original targets. Revenue reached Rp10.4 trillion, up 147% year‑on‑year, while net profit surged 805% to Rp2.7 trillion and EBITDA climbed 363% to Rp3.9 trillion, surpassing the full‑year RKAP EBITDA target. Total assets grew 21% to Rp16.4 trillion, cash rose to about Rp4 trillion and equity increased to Rp10.5 trillion, while cash cost is projected to rise to US$23,000‑24,000 per metric ton by year‑end. The company allocated roughly Rp446 billion for 2026 capex, with half earmarked for production and exploration and the remainder for non‑recurring investments.

results.title: Summary of stock recommendations for 8 September 2026 from seven Indonesian securities firms.
results.body: The article summarizes stock recommendations issued by seven Indonesian securities firms for Tuesday, 8 September 2026, following a 0.25% decline in the IHSG to 6,619 on Monday. The index fell amid weakness in financial, raw material, and technology sectors, which dropped 0.75%, 0.71%, and 0.61% respectively, with trading volume of 37.05 billion shares worth Rp13.73 trillion. The brokers recommended a total of 24 stocks: IMPC, TINS, KOTA from BRI Danareksa Sekuritas; SSIA, ADRO, BBRI, ERAA, COCO, COIN from BNI Sekuritas; HMSP, MDIA from Phillip Sekuritas; HRUM, INKP, MDKA, TPIA from MNC Sekuritas; HMSP, INDF, BTPS, TAPG, CMRY, BUMI from CGS International Sekuritas; INDF, INKP, AKRA, BFIN, MNCN from Phintraco Sekuritas; and ADRO, DEWA, INKP from Mirae Asset Sekuritas. Several stocks, including HMSP, INKP, ADRO, and INDF, were recommended by multiple firms.

results.title: IHSG forecast to reach 6,700 amid Anak Krakatau eruption concerns, with BBCA, BBRI, BMRI under pressure and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommending IMPC, TINS, KOTA, UDNG.
results.body: The article forecasts that Indonesia's composite index (IHSG) could climb to the 6,600‑6,700 range, with a key resistance at 6,700, despite the ongoing Anak Krakatau eruption. On Monday the index slipped 0.25% to 6,619.67, staying above the 20‑day moving average and with a positive MACD, while foreign‑exchange reserves rose to US$146.5 billion supporting domestic sentiment. Technical pressure is coming from BBCA, BBRI and BMRI, whereas BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends swing‑trade positions in IMPC and TINS, a day‑trade in KOTA, and a sell stance on UDNG. The market’s near‑term direction may be swayed by the U.S. CPI release on 11 September, projected at 3.4% headline and 2.4% core inflation, which could affect risk appetite and the index’s trajectory.

results.title: IHSG Projected to Remain Limited on Tuesday (Sept 8), Sentiment Overview
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is projected to trade within a limited range on Tuesday (Sept 8) after closing at 6,619.67, down 16.80 points (0.25%) on Monday, with analysts noting pressure from big‑cap financial stocks BBCA, BBRI and BMRI while health and energy sectors provide support and technical levels suggest support near 6,603‑6,600 and resistance near 6,632‑6,700. Analysts from MNC Sekuritas and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas set target prices for HRUM (Rp 985‑1,015), INKP (Rp 9,250‑9,500), MDKA (Rp 2,980‑3,020) and recommend buying IMPC (Rp 1,605‑1,730), TINS (Rp 4,610‑4,830) and KOTA (Rp 224‑236) as the market watches upcoming NFP, China trade‑balance and US CPI releases and Indonesia’s foreign‑exchange reserves at US$146.5 billion.

results.title: Analysts Recommend Five Stocks for Correction-Prone Week as IHSG Faces Mixed Outlook
results.body: Analysts from Kiwoom Sekuritas and MNC Sekuritas recommended five stocks for the week of September 7 as the IHSG faces potential correction amid US-Iran tensions and upcoming US inflation data. The IHSG closed at 6,636 on September 4, down 0.47% for the day but up 1.82% for the week, while foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp29.76 billion. Kiwoom's Oktavianus Audi projects the index to move between support 6,575 and resistance 6,718, recommending PT Petrosea Tbk (target 5,950 from 5,375) and PT Timah Tbk (target 4,720 from 4,420). MNC's Herditya Wicaksana sees support at 6,337 and resistance at 6,786, recommending PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk (target 1,365 from 1,310), PT Elnusa Tbk (target 830 from 730), and PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk (target 1,365 from 1,185).

results.title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends CUAN, TINS and INET for Monday, 7 September 2026
results.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas issued a stock recommendation for three Indonesian equities on Monday, 7 September 2026. The broker sees PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk potentially extending its rally above the 895 level, targeting 970‑1,020, supported by rising volume, a positive MACD, and notes CUAN plans to acquire a majority stake in PT Singaraja Putri Tbk. TINS is projected to continue upward momentum after breaking out above 4,210, with a price target of 4,610‑4,830; the company reported first‑half 2026 net profit of Rp 2.71 trillion, 169 % of its Rp 1.61 trillion profit target. INET remains bullish on a breakout pattern and MA200 cross, trading above 350 with a target of 372‑390, while foreign investors recorded net buying of Rp 91.3 billion in the regular market over the past month.

results.title: IHSG Predicted Mixed on Monday (Sept 7), Investors Cautioned on Rupiah and US‑Iran Conflict
results.body: Analysts forecast that Indonesia's composite stock index (IHSG) will trade within a narrow range of 6,580–6,700 on Monday, with support at 6,580–6,600 and resistance at 6,680–6,700 amid mixed sentiment. They cite foreign net buying of roughly Rp1.6 trillion in the past week, a Rupiah level near Rp17,642 per USD, and Brent crude around US$95 per barrel as factors that could influence the index while monitoring Fed policy cues and the US‑Iran conflict. Specific equities highlighted as potential drivers include PT Bukit Asam Tbk (target Rp3,100), PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (target Rp1,100), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (target Rp250), PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (target Rp400), PT Petrosea Tbk (buy on break at Rp5,500, resistance Rp5,950) and PT Timah Tbk (trading buy with support Rp4,150, resistance Rp4,720). The outlook remains sensitive to any shift in US labor data, Treasury yields, or escalation of tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, which could affect energy stocks and overall market sentiment.

results.title: Foreign investors' top ten net‑buy stocks on 4 Sep 2026 amid a 0.47% IHSG correction
results.body: The article reports that foreign investors net bought ten Indonesian stocks on Friday 4 Sep 2026 while the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) corrected 0.47% to 6,636.47. The market closed within a range of 6,633–6,704, with total share volume of 35.8 billion and transaction value of Rp 15.04 trillion, and foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 29.80 billion that day. Over the week, foreign investors accumulated a net buy of Rp 1.85 trillion, and the ten most purchased stocks were PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (Rp 196.83 billion), PT Timah Tbk (Rp 158.76 billion), PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (Rp 46.47 billion), PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (Rp 33.6 billion), PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk (Rp 25.27 billion), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (Rp 24.54 billion), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (Rp 24.45 billion), PT Bukit Asam Tbk (Rp 19.11 billion), PT Sumber Global Energy Tbk (Rp 13.25 billion) and PT United Tractors Tbk (Rp 10.43 billion). These companies were directly impacted by the foreign investors' net purchases, while the IHSG still posted a weekly gain of 1.82% despite the weekend correction.

results.title: First-Half 2026 Net Profit Rises Sharply for Indonesian BUMNs, Analysts Cite Danantara's Restructuring and Issue Stock Recommendations
results.body: First-half 2026 net profit surged across major Indonesian state-owned enterprises, with PT Semen Indonesia Tbk posting Rp 228.25 billion (up 408.9% YoY), PT Aneka Tambang Tbk earning Rp 6.91 trillion (up 34% YoY), PT Timah Tbk - whose profit is attributed to the parent entity's owners - reporting Rp 2.71 trillion, 169% of its Rp 1.61 trillion target, and PT Bank Tabungan Tbk achieving Rp 2.40 trillion (up 40.8% YoY), while PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, PT PP Tbk and PT Adhi Karya Tbk also posted double-digit profit growth. Analysts recommend buying BMRI on weakness with a target of Rp 5,800, accumulating PT Timah Tbk at Rp 5,500, accumulating INCO at Rp 5,000-6,000, targeting PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk at Rp 4,500, and taking short-term trading positions in PT Timah Tbk between Rp 4,600-4,720. They attribute much of the earnings boost to sector-specific factors such as commodity price recoveries and demand rebounds, while noting Danantara's capital injections into PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk and PT Krakatau Steel Tbk as broader restructuring catalysts. Risks remain from rupiah exchange-rate movements, global market conditions, commodity volatility, and the execution of Danantara's restructuring of BUMN Karya.

results.title: PT Timah Tbk records the most aggressive growth among Indonesian miners in H1 2026, surpassing PT Antam Tbk, PT Bukit Asam Tbk and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
results.body: PT Timah Tbk posted the strongest performance among Indonesian mining issuers in the MIND ID ecosystem during the first half of 2026, with revenue rising 146.9% to Rp 10.4 trillion and net profit surging 804.6% to Rp 2.7 trillion. In comparison, PT Antam Tbk generated Rp 62.7 trillion of revenue (+6.3%) and Rp 6.39 trillion of net profit (+36.0%); PT Bukit Asam Tbk reported Rp 22.03 trillion of revenue (+7.7%) and Rp 2.65 trillion of net profit (+218%); PT Vale Indonesia Tbk recorded Rp 9.6 trillion of revenue (+27.4%) and Rp 1.85 trillion of net profit (+313.6%). The analyst attributes PT Timah’s outperformance to higher tin prices, increased sales volume, and a low prior profit base, while noting heightened volatility risk. Sustained tin prices and production in the second half of 2026 will be critical for maintaining the momentum.

results.title: Foreign investors buy large stakes in BBRI, BBCA and TPIA as the IHSG nears 6,600
results.body: Foreign investors bought large stakes in several Indonesian blue‑chip stocks as the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,599.94, up 1.14% and approaching the 6,600 level. The net foreign purchases for the day totaled Rp2.03 trillion, with the top‑buy stocks being BBRI (Rp838 billion), BBCA (Rp435.4 billion), BMRI (Rp172.3 billion), TPIA (Rp131.1 billion), CPIN (Rp74.3 billion), SMGR (Rp56.1 billion), ESSA (Rp50.8 billion), TAPG (Rp36.3 billion), TINS (Rp34 billion) and AADI (Rp27.7 billion). The buying occurred amid macro data showing August inflation of 0.21% month‑on‑month (3.19% year‑on‑year) and a July trade surplus of US$120 million, and Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia’s research head noted a higher probability of the IHSG staying in the green zone in September.

results.title: BNI Sekuritas forecasts a modest rise in the IHSG and issues buy recommendations for six Indonesian stocks
results.body: BNI Sekuritas' head of retail research, Fanny Suherman, said the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is likely to move sideways but could strengthen after the recent MSCI rebalancing, with support at 6,450‑6,500 and resistance at 6,580‑6,620. The index closed at 6,525.47 on 31 August 2026, up 0.11%, while foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 711 billion, led by sales of CPIN, EMAS, UNVR, ASII and TPIA. BNI Sekuritas issued speculative‑buy recommendations for PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk (target Rp 450‑460), PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk (target Rp 150‑160), PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (target Rp 3,020‑3,100), and speculative‑buy for PT Timah Tbk (target Rp 4,080‑4,130). It also advised a buy‑on‑weakness for PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (target Rp 1,125‑1,140) and PT Bayan Resources Tbk (target Rp 14,300‑14,600).

results.title: IHSG projected sideways‑bearish for September 2026 with key support at 6,400‑6,500 and stock picks from Phintraco and Sucor Sekuritas
results.body: The article projects Indonesia’s composite index (IHSG) to trade sideways‑bearish in September 2026, likely ranging between 6,400 and 6,700 points with support at 6,400‑6,500 and resistance near 6,700. Analysts cite a forward P/E of 9.8×, a stable BI‑Rate of 5.75%, and a 1.11% rupiah appreciation to Rp17,876/USD as factors supporting a modest outlook, while historical September performance shows an average gain of only 0.02% over 20 years and a 10‑year average loss of 0.94%. Phintraco Sekuritas analyst Alrich Paskalis Tambolang recommends BBCA, BMRI, TLKM, ASII and PGEO with target prices of Rp6,800, Rp4,500, Rp2,800, Rp5,300 and Rp1,150 respectively. Sucor Sekuritas manager Hendry Wijaya suggests BRMS, INET, VKTR, TAPG, TINS and PTRO with target‑price ranges and cut‑loss levels as listed. The MSCI rebalancing effective 1 September, which removed several small‑cap stocks and re‑classified GOTO and CPIN, is noted but not expected to drive a sharp index decline.

results.title: PT Timah Tbk reports 146.9% revenue surge and 804.7% net profit jump in H1 2026 after governance overhaul
results.body: PT Timah Tbk (TINS) has strengthened its corporate governance, highlighted by a management refresh that appointed Restu Widiyantoro as President Director and Agus Rohman as President Commissioner/Independent. The government’s crackdown on illegal tin mining and the presidential emphasis on resource stewardship are cited as contextual drivers. In the first half of 2026, the company posted revenue of Rp 10.42 trillion (up 146.9% YoY) and net profit of Rp 2.72 trillion (up 804.7% YoY), with production and sales rising 74.8% and 85.1% respectively. The market responded, with TINS shares gaining 29.58% year‑to‑date and closing at Rp 4,030 on 21 August 2026.
